- **User intent.** Subagents lack conversation; retain interpretation/taste; each assignment gets all slice requirements.
- **Cap:** At most 32 subagents concurrently; excess queues. `tasks[]` batch > 32 delays results: stay within cap.
- **Dependencies only.** A before B only if B strictly needs A; shared prerequisite inline, then fan out. “Parallelize” = parallel execution of independent slices, not agents routing sequential work. Small missing piece: run parallel; B asks A via `hub`!

- Multi-file work: plan before files.

# 2. Research Before Editing

# 3. Decompose
- Update todos; skip trivial requests.

# 4. Implement
- Fix source; NEVER suppress symptom/special-case input unless asked.
- Clean cutover: migrate every caller; remove obsolete code/comments/aliases/re-exports/deprecated paths.
- Prefer existing-file updates over new files. Review as user.

# 5. Verify
- NEVER yield non-trivial work without deliverable proof:
  - **Experiment/investigation** → run; output is proof; no tests.
  - **UI change** → browser-drive; visual confirmation is proof; no tests unless existing suite really breaks.
  - **Bug fix** → reproduce, fix, confirm reproduction no longer triggers.
  - **Permanent feature/API change** → existing changed-contract tests. Add test only for uncovered new observable contract or user request.
- Smoke test: run thing, not test file; launch, exercise changed path, observe result.
- Tests (not default): each MUST defend observable contract/fail on plausible bug. Test behavior, boundaries, invariants, transitions, precedence, real errors—not plumbing, source text, incidental defaults. Match conventions; deterministic, isolated, full-suite-safe.

# 6. Cleanup
Last phase; REQUIRED after smoke test proves work; NEVER pre-plan/pre-allocate cleanup todos.

content.text: Result submitted.

1_duplicate_repos_denial.change: Removed standalone `|| path.starts_with("/repos/")` branch and its 4-line comment from the `denied` expression in `runner_surface_only`; `DENIED_PREFIXES` const still contains `"/repos/"` so `/repos/*` remains denied via the const. Grep confirms no other `/repos/` reference remains.

2_openapi_400_responses.change: Inserted `(status = 400, description = "Malformed JSON body", body = ApiErrorResponse)` directly after 204 in both dispatch ops: `workflow_dispatch_trigger` now 204,400,401,403,404,409,422; `repository_dispatch_trigger` now 204,400,401,403,404,422. utoipa tuple syntax preserved.

3_openapi_security_scheme.change: Rewrote `github_dispatch_bearer` description: credential list intact (installation token, own-App JWT, PAT, system token); now states dispatches require the endpoint's write permission on the repository (`actions: write` workflow dispatch, `contents: write` repository dispatch) and read endpoints require repository read access.

4_pat_actor_test_hermetic.change: `dispatch_with_pat_authenticates` now uses `let _env = pin_api_base("http://127.0.0.1:1").await;` instead of manual `GITHUB_ENV_LOCK.lock()` — no double-lock (pin_api_base acquires it once, same pattern as line 880). Updated the stale comment to explain deterministic pinning. Assertion `actor == "preloop-pat"` kept.

5_rd_broken_fixture_comment.change: Added 6-line `//` comment above `RD_BROKEN` const explaining `submit_run_inner` validates `on.schedule` crons via `validate_schedule_crons` on every submitted workflow, so the invalid cron is a hard per-workflow submission failure (not trigger matching) — what the broadcast test exercises. No behavior change.

data.verification: All edited regions re-read post-patch; grep confirms 400 entries at openapi.rs lines 605/631 directly after their 204s and only the const entry denies /repos/ in auth.rs. No cargo run performed per constraints. Only the three assigned files were modified.
